description: This file defines a custom RecyclerView.ItemDecoration called SectionItemDecoration that adds spacing (offsets) around items identified as section headers in a RecyclerView, specifically for the Notes app's Android client.

classes.name: SectionItemDecoration
classes.description: A custom item decoration for RecyclerView that adds spacing around section header items.

methods.name: SectionItemDecoration
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the decoration with the adapter and spacing dimensions.

methods.name: getItemOffsets
methods.description: Overrides RecyclerView.ItemDecoration.getItemOffsets to add space around section header items.
